Network construction for active ingredients and targets

Network construction for active ingredients and targets. The purple square denotes the bioactive compound of Ligusticum wallichii, while the yellow square signifies the shared targets between this compound and Alzheimer’s disease. The blue square indicates the signaling pathways associated with Alzheimer’s disease-related targets
